//*************************************************
// The view returns all software components from HOME/LOCAL/CUSTOMER which might not have ABAP LANGUAGE VERSION 5
// and which are relevant for Snapshot Creation.
// In SAP Cloud Platform ABAP environment, this is empty as only ALV = 5 Components are allowed
// In onPremise all Software Components of type C + HOME + LOCAL should be returned
// excluding installed components
//
// Element Definition:
// - SOFTWARE_COMPONENT: Software component name 
//*************************************************
@AbapCatalog.sqlViewName: 'ARS_SWC_CSREL'
@AbapCatalog.compiler.compareFilter: true
@AbapCatalog.preserveKey: true
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_ALLOWED
@EndUserText.label: 'Software Components relevant Snapshot'
define view ARS_SWC_CUST_SNAPSHOT_RELEVANT
  as select from cvers as cvers
  left outer join abap_langu_swcmp as ars_swc on ars_swc.dlvunit                        = 'LOCAL' and
                                                 ars_swc.allowed_abap_language_versions = 'S' 
{
  key  cvers.component as software_component
}
where
      ars_swc.dlvunit is null and         // ensures that the system does not have a cloud-like software component configuration
    ( cvers.comp_type = #relc_type.'C' or // Customer project component
      cvers.comp_type = #relc_type.'M' or // HOME
      cvers.comp_type = #relc_type.'L' or // LOCAL
      cvers.comp_type = #relc_type.'J'  ) // ZLOCAL
